title.purpose: App name in the header, the only weight+size emphasis moment.

metric.purpose: Live RMSSD/SDNN/LF/HF values; the visual focal point.

body.purpose: Base document font; rarely seen directly.

label.purpose: Panel titles, metric-tile headers, control captions.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: SVG trace glow, colored by the signal it belongs to.

shadows.name: metric-glow
shadows.purpose: Pulsing glow on live metric values (glowBreathe animation).

shadows.name: popover-shadow
shadows.purpose: The one physical drop-shadow in the system, on the info-tag popover only.

motion.name: pulse-flash
motion.purpose: Heartbeat dot flash on each new beat in the header.

motion.name: glow-breathe
motion.purpose: Idle pulse on metric-tile values signaling live data.

components.name: Export Button
components.description: Bordered panel button, top-right of the header, exports the three SVG charts as a PNG.
components.css: .ds-export-btn { background: #0e161d; border: 1px solid #1b2733; color: #d7e2ea; padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; } .ds-export-btn:active { border-color: #2fe7c9; }

components.name: Preset Button
components.description: Age-preset quick-select buttons (Young / Older) that jump vagal tone to a representative value.
components.css: .ds-preset-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #1b2733; background: #0e161d; color: #d7e2ea; font-weight: 500; } .ds-preset-btn:active { border-color: #b18bff; color: #b18bff; }

components.name: Metric Tile
components.description: Displays one live HRV metric (label, tap-to-reveal info, glowing tabular-nums value) in its assigned signal color.
components.css: .ds-metric-tile { background: #0b1117; border: 1px solid #1b2733; border-radius: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; } .ds-metric-tile__head { color: #7c8fa0; font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.6px; } .ds-metric-tile__value { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--tile-color); text-shadow: 0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--tile-color) 55%, transparent); } .ds-metric-tile__unit { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: #7c8fa0; margin-left: 4px; }

components.name: Chart Panel
components.description: Bordered container for each SVG chart (tachogram, PSD, Poincare) with an uppercase dim title.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #0b1117; border: 1px solid #1b2733; border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 14px 6px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-panel__title { font-size: 13px; color: #7c8fa0; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.6px; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-panel__svg { flex: 1; width: 100%; min-height: 120px; }

components.name: Range Slider
components.description: Teal-to-violet gradient track with a white teal-bordered thumb; drives breathing rate and vagal tone.
components.html: <input type="range" class="ds-range" min="6" max="24" step="0.5" value="12">
components.css: .ds-range { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 44px; background: transparent; } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2fe7c9, #b18bff); } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 30px; height: 30px; margin-top: -11px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; border: 3px solid #2fe7c9; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(47, 231, 201, 0.6); }

components.name: Info Tag
components.description: Tap-to-reveal 'i' button that opens a definition popover; the system's one floating/overlay element with a real drop-shadow.
components.html: Definition text goes here.
components.css: .ds-info-tag { position: relative; display: inline-flex; } .ds-info-tag__btn { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #7c8fa0; background: transparent; color: #7c8fa0; font-size: 12px; font-style: italic; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-info-tag__popover { position: absolute; z-index: 20; top: 26px; left: 0; width: 240px; background: #10181f; border: 1px solid #1b2733; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: #d7e2ea; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }

narrative.overview: The whole interface reads as an instrument, not an app: a near-black field, a handful of glowing traces, numbers that visibly breathe. Every design decision serves one goal -- a thesis-defense audience or a student dragging a slider should see the physiology happen, not read a caption explaining it. Density stays low and the layout stays single-screen: no navigation, no scrolling mid-demo, nothing between the presenter's hand and the result on screen. This system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS-dashboard look (cream backgrounds, card grids, gradient text, hero-metric tiles) and the static textbook-figure look (flat, printed, non-responsive). It is not decorated; every glow, pulse, and shadow earns its place by reinforcing that the signal is live.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black void with three glowing signal colors, nothing else competing for attention
Numbers that pulse and glow in sync with the underlying data, not static labels
Compact, dense, single-viewport layout -- built to survive a live demo, not a scroll
Tabular numerals everywhere a value updates, so nothing jitters mid-sentence

rules.name: The Three-Signal Rule
rules.body: Only teal, violet, and amber ever represent data. If a fourth data series is ever added, reuse one of the three with a different visual encoding before introducing a new color.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that updates in real time uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The No-Gray-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Panels and cards never cast a shadow. The only shadows in the system are colored signal glow and the one popover overlay.

dos: Do keep the whole experience on one screen with no navigation or scrolling during a live demo.
Do use tabular-nums on every value that updates in real time.
Do reserve signal glow (drop-shadow / text-shadow in the data's own color) for things that are actually live data, not decoration.
Do keep buttons at the single bordered-panel treatment; don't invent a second, higher-emphasis button style.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for the pulse-dot flash and metric-tile glow-breathe animation.
donts: Don't introduce a cream/warm-neutral background or card-grid dashboard layout.
Don't flatten the charts into static, non-glowing figures.
Don't add a fourth data color. Reuse teal/violet/amber with a different encoding first.
Don't add a gray/black box-shadow to a panel or metric tile.
Don't repurpose --c-red for anything but a genuine error/alert state.
